entities.name: PMID:25428923
observations: Directly compared MRSA ST22-IV with ST228-I under oxidative stress, autolytic activity, high osmolarity, acidic and alkaline conditions, desiccation, and heat shock.
Reported ST22-IV had superior survival or resistance under every tested stress condition; accessible abstract did not provide numerical effect sizes.

entities.name: MRSA ST22-IV
observations: Had superior survival or resistance versus ST228-I across the complete stress panel tested in PMID 25428923.
Direct evidence does not establish superiority for antimicrobial peptides, disinfectants, or starvation.

entities.name: MRSA ST228-I
observations: Showed lower survival or stress resistance than ST22-IV across the tested conditions in the direct comparison reported by PMID 25428923.

entities.name: ST22-IV stress advantage
observations: In the principal direct comparison, ST22-IV outperformed ST228-I under oxidative, osmotic, acidic, alkaline, desiccation, and heat-shock conditions and showed greater resistance to autolytic activity.
The evidence supports a broad advantage for the tested panel, but effect magnitude, reproducibility across isolates, and universality across other stresses remain unresolved.

entities.name: PMID:35972129
observations: A 2022 study of 98 MRSA strains found approximately one-log overall reduction after one week of dehydration and no overall epidemic-versus-nonepidemic difference; its abstract mentioned prior ST22-IV versus ST228-I dehydration findings but did not establish a direct quantitative comparison.
